steps.method: Record the original question, region if supplied, time horizon, and what trade or defense question the evidence could inform.
In this repository a broad discovery request defaults to shortlist, selected-case investigation, executable tests and a final report. Honor an explicit shortlist-only or narrower request.
Infer routine choices and state assumptions. Ask only when the answer changes scope or needed authority; continue independent work.
Record event dates, retrieval time, source timezone/precision, coordinate reference and measurement units. Convert supported timestamps to UTC while retaining originals.
Define what counts as a completed search and test round. A defensible inconclusive or no-anomaly report is a valid endpoint.
Read relevant GEV evidence instructions and available tool descriptions; distinguish local app, read-only connector and external research capabilities.
Call the available GEV source inventory before queries. Record health, pagination, provenance, coverage, retention and supported history endpoints.

steps.action: Locate the running app when needed
steps.method: Discover current runtime and active case rather than reusing an old host or port. Inspect existing cases before editing them.
Query relevant aircraft, aircraft classification and satellite feeds within supported limits. Treat an interface validation error separately from an upstream request failure.
Distinguish observed aircraft position, MLAT solution, satellite catalog element, propagated position, official notice and an external lead.
Record which conclusions came from GEV and which came from outside reports. Never label a web lead as an anomaly detected in GEV.
Use permitted APIs, local provider routes or ordinary published viewers. Record missing access and stop dependent tests when essential evidence is unavailable.
Split independent aircraft, satellite, source/provenance and external-context checks when useful. Give each a bounded output.
Search selected regions or a documented global sample. Retain query bounds, returned counts, pagination and position age; one snapshot is not a baseline.
Check primary regulators, operators, official statistics and original technical analyses. Preserve event date separately from publication date.
Compare with known routes, schedules, maneuvers, sensor coverage, software behavior and service events as applicable.
Label each lead observed candidate, reported lead, context-only, unsupported, or unobservable. Record missing baseline or raw data explicitly.
Consider evidence quality, deviation from a relevant baseline, plausible operational significance and availability of a discriminating test. Avoid invented precise probabilities.
Follow the user selection; otherwise choose the best-supported, testable case and explain the choice. If none qualifies, produce a negative or evidence-gap report.

stages.title: Freeze the case and comparison plan

steps.method: Create an isolated run with the workflow version, scope, selected entities and original lead links.
Define study windows and geographic/altitude/orbital bounds before extending observations. Do not move windows merely to obtain a favorable result.
Specify record, aircraft, pass, event and duration separately. Identify the eligible population or acknowledge a convenience sample.
Choose physically relevant time, place, equipment, altitude or orbital matches. Keep missing, excluded, source-switched and healthy records distinct.
Record amendments and reasons before retrieving or examining the next batch. Preserve earlier versions; distinguish discovery from confirmation.
Save allowed raw response bodies or structured snapshots with URLs, query parameters, timestamps, status and schema/provider version.
Use supported pagination or the documented full-history endpoint. Count raw records and record actual first/last event coverage.
Bind identifiers, registration/catalog identity, callsign or mission label to the relevant interval; do not apply the latest flight label to an earlier flight.
Keep previous and refreshed versions with hashes and retrieval times. Use an explicit latest-version rule for aggregate counts.
Read the applicable field definitions and, when material, pinned decoder/serialization or propagation versions. Do not silently substitute current code.
Preserve tool validation failure, DNS/network failure, HTTP status, empty payload, unavailable history and unsupported browser export as distinct outcomes.
Verify that another provider actually covers the original event. Later flights or a live page are not historical corroboration.
Check copied bytes/hashes, parseability, ordering, duplicates, timestamps, units and coordinate ranges without rewriting preserved inputs.
Separate zero, missing, invalid, stale-marked and not-applicable values. Quality categories are not measurements of actual error.
Retain position-source labels and explicit state objects. A fresh position does not establish freshness of every metadata field.
Mark source changes, long gaps, time discontinuities and relevant stale flags. Do not create measured paths by joining incompatible records.
Compare snapshot age with position age, identify ground transmitters, check selection through potentially corrupted positions and account for unobserved entities.
Apply documented region, event, altitude, source and metadata rules; record retained and excluded counts at each step.
Measure durations, geographic or orbital residuals, source disagreement, implied motion and quality-state changes using the appropriate domain adapter.
Distinguish a single jump from a sustained or recurrent branch. Describe spread, range, sample spacing and retained duration honestly.
Seek within-entity normal/abnormal passes and contemporaneous controls. Expose time/location/altitude/equipment confounding.
Compare coordinate-derived motion and reported motion; inspect retained metadata and source-specific branches. Do not treat derived fields as independent sensors.
If fitting loops, trends or changepoints, preserve fitting choices, residuals and sensitivity. A fitted center or period is not a source or intent fingerprint.
Describe exactly what is anomalous in the saved evidence before proposing its physical or operational cause.

stages.title: Create and verify the GEV evidence view

steps.method: When GEV map writing is available and within scope, construct case metadata, source entries, UTC timeline, reported-location pins and defensible paths.
Distinguish reported, independently verified, approximate and unknown positions. In a positioning anomaly, provider coordinates do not mean true position.
Keep ADS-B, MLAT and other branches separate; split unsupported gaps and transitions. Never draw an inferred route as measured motion.
Use the installed case contract and publisher, preserve other cases and backups, and honor filesystem permissions. Do not use a read-only connector as a writer.
Open the actual case. Check title, selected evidence, pin locations, source details, filters, timeline and relevant original-source links.
Check source visibility controls, legends, units, timestamps and served report/data bytes. Restore the complete intended view after testing filters.
Include real-world change, measurement/processing artifact, equipment behavior, environmental effects and ordinary operations where relevant. Hypotheses may coexist.
For each hypothesis state what should differ, in which records, at what time and relative to which comparator.
State a result that would weaken the claim and the evidence needed to distinguish it from its strongest alternative.
Distinguish publisher, feeder, receiver, decoder and onboard independence. Record asynchronous fields and shared software/configuration.
Prioritize passive tests with available data and high ability to distinguish causes. Mark unavailable raw-message or onboard tests explicitly.
Identify the evidence needed for trade impact, resilience consequences or attribution; anomalous geometry alone does not establish these.

steps.action: Record a test plan before calculating
steps.method: Version the input set, event window, thresholds, expected outcomes and eligibility rules; label post-discovery sensitivity analysis honestly.
Check source-label consistency, stale flags, ordering, frozen metadata, extreme points and coordinate-derived motion as applicable.
Vary source-transition buffers, outlier screens and matching tolerances; report when a strict filter removes all usable data.
Test whether the strongest normal/abnormal comparison survives stricter position, altitude, direction and source rules.
Separate record coincidence from event onset; test sensitivity to stale records and source transitions. Exclusions may remove genuine effects.

steps.action: Expand the cohort with a recorded rule
steps.method: Acquire all eligible additional histories within the bounded selection plan; preserve amendments and refresh versions.
Count eligible and ineligible comparisons. Zero matched controls means insufficient evidence, not healthy traffic or absence of an effect.
Use another authorized archive or published viewer. Compare actual timestamps, coordinates and precision; preserve sparse manual readings as such.
Record shared feeder/software possibilities. Only perform independent decoding if original messages and required metadata actually exist.
Align official local/global environmental observations, satellite or navigation service notices and closures with the actual event windows.
Verify notice closures, future scheduled events, cached pages, missing product windows and differences between estimates and finalized measurements.

steps.action: Record executed outcomes and blocked tests
steps.method: Store measured values, inputs, method and result for each executed test; preserve failure/unknown/not-applicable states without inventing a finding.
Use a separate calculation or reviewer for central counts, geometry, filters and comparisons where useful. Review discrepancies rather than voting.
Check whether the evidence supports a feed anomaly, a physical effect, a mechanism, an actor or an operational impact; do not skip levels.
Use evidence-linked supported, weakened, inconclusive, not-tested or not-applicable judgments. Avoid calibrated odds without a justified model.
Supersede earlier synchronization, coverage or service-status claims wherever they matter. Preserve the historical record with explicit correction notes.
Name the specific missing observation and how it would discriminate causes. Do not turn a blocked test into an unrequested outreach or monitoring task.

stages.title: Deliver and preserve a reusable result

steps.method: Lead with findings and revised hypotheses, then methods, actual test outcomes, uncertainty, implications and source/reproduction information.
Check tables, links, figures and timestamps. If producing PDF, render and visually inspect it. Check map/report accessibility when publishing locally.
Include permitted raw inputs, plans, calculations, results, source notes and a manifest. Keep credentials, personal machine paths and unrelated logs out of shared artifacts.
Rerun deterministic calculations in an isolated copy; compare results without refetching rolling sources or altering original evidence.
Check archive integrity and links; for Git delivery confirm the remote commit and files. State exactly what was delivered and any access limitations.
Record workflow version, case state, revised verdicts and the next discriminating evidence so another model can resume without chat memory.
